sfx-pencil-line.prompt: A single graphite pencil line drawn quickly across heavy paper. Close, dry, small. No reverb, no room tone, no music.

sfx-ui-click.prompt: One soft muted mechanical key press. Very close, dry, short, low. No reverb, no click echo, no music.

sfx-tick.prompt: A single faint mechanical clock tick, small and distant, dry. No reverb, no music, no ticking loop.

sfx-paper-settle.prompt: A large sheet of drafting paper settling onto a wooden desk: one soft slap, then a brief rustle as it flattens. Close, dry. No reverb, no music.

sfx-paper-sweep.prompt: A short soft sweep of a paper sheet moving past the microphone. Air only. No crinkle, no metallic tone, no reverb, no music.

sfx-instrument.prompt: A small brass drafting compass set down on a wooden desk. One clean click and a tiny settle. Close, dry. No reverb, no music.

sfx-warm-swell.prompt: A soft low warm air swell rising smoothly and stopping. No impact, no hit, no reverb tail, no music, no whoosh sweep.

sfx-stamp.prompt: A rubber stamp pressed once onto paper on a hard desk. One dry thud with a short wooden knock. Close. No reverb, no room, no music.

sfx-room-air.prompt: A very low continuous air tone in a large empty quiet room. Almost inaudible, flat and even from beginning to end, no movement and no shape. Close and warm. No hum, no drone note, no pitch, no hiss sweep, no rise, no reverb tail, no music.

sfx-paper-rush.prompt: A large sheet of paper rushing past the microphone in one fast pass. Grain and air, accelerating and then stopping cleanly. Close, dry. No crinkle, no tearing, no synth whoosh sweep, no reverb tail, no music.

sfx-final-settle.prompt: A single sheet of paper coming to rest on a wooden desk and going completely still. One soft contact, then nothing. Close, dry, small. No rustle loop, no second contact, no reverb, no music.

sfx-detent.prompt: One small sprung mechanical detent, a dial passing a single notch. Very close, dry, tiny, low. One event only. No reverb, no echo, no rattle, no spring ring, no music.
